class SegmentTree {
public:
    vector<long long> segtree1;
    vector<long long> segtree2;
    vector<int> arr;
    int n;

    SegmentTree(const vector<int>& a, int size) {
        arr = a;
        n = size;
        segtree1.resize(4 * n, 0);
        segtree2.resize(4 * n, 0);
    }

    void oddbuild(int low, int high, int pos) {
        if (low == high) {
            if (low % 2 == 1)
                segtree1[pos] = arr[low];
        } else {
            int middle = (low + high) / 2;
            oddbuild(low, middle, 2 * pos + 1);
            oddbuild(middle + 1, high, 2 * pos + 2);
            segtree1[pos] = segtree1[2 * pos + 1] + segtree1[2 * pos + 2];
        }
    }

    void evenbuild(int low, int high, int pos) {
        if (low == high) {
            if (low % 2 == 0)
                segtree2[pos] = arr[low];
        } else {
            int middle = (low + high) / 2;
            evenbuild(low, middle, 2 * pos + 1);
            evenbuild(middle + 1, high, 2 * pos + 2);
            segtree2[pos] = segtree2[2 * pos + 1] + segtree2[2 * pos + 2];
        }
    }

    long long oddans(int low, int high, int pos, int ql, int qh) {
        if (ql <= low && qh >= high)
            return segtree1[pos];
        else if (ql > high || qh < low)
            return 0;
        int middle = (low + high) / 2;
        long long left = oddans(low, middle, 2 * pos + 1, ql, qh);
        long long right = oddans(middle + 1, high, 2 * pos + 2, ql, qh);
        return left + right;
    }

    long long evenans(int low, int high, int pos, int ql, int qh) {
        if (ql <= low && qh >= high)
            return segtree2[pos];
        else if (ql > high || qh < low)
            return 0;
        int middle = (low + high) / 2;
        long long left = evenans(low, middle, 2 * pos + 1, ql, qh);
        long long right = evenans(middle + 1, high, 2 * pos + 2, ql, qh);
        return left + right;
    }
};

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    Reader::init(cin);

    int n = Reader::nextInt();
    int b = Reader::nextInt();

    vector<int> arr(n + 1, 0);
    vector<int> oddcount(n + 1, 0);
    vector<int> evencount(n + 1, 0);

    for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
        arr[i] = Reader::nextInt();
        if (arr[i] % 2 == 1) {
            oddcount[i] = oddcount[i - 1] + 1;
            evencount[i] = evencount[i - 1];
        } else {
            oddcount[i] = oddcount[i - 1];
            evencount[i] = evencount[i - 1] + 1;
        }
    }

    int cut = 0;
    int size = n / 2 - 1;
    vector<int> arr2(size, -1);
    for (int i = 2; i < n; i += 2) {
        if (oddcount[i] == evencount[i]) {
            arr2[i / 2 - 1] = abs(arr[i] - arr[i + 1]);
        } else {
            arr2[i / 2 - 1] = -1;
        }
    }

    sort(arr2.begin(), arr2.end());

    long long sum = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < size; ++i) {
        if (arr2[i] != -1 && sum + arr2[i] <= b) {
            ++cut;
            sum += arr2[i];
        }
    }

    cout << cut << "\n";

    return 0;
}
